display_long_description:
Bring the chessboard into your world.

Scacchi MR places a full-size chess table right in your room thanks to Meta Quest passthrough. A virtual opponent sits in front of you, thinks about its moves and plays them by hand, just like a real game across the table.

Play naturally

Pick up and move pieces with your hands (hand tracking) or with the controllers
Legal moves are highlighted as soon as you grab a piece
Grab the golden handles to move and rotate the table wherever you like
A real opponent at your table.

What's new
• New Master level: your opponent thinks longer and prunes weak moves to see further ahead. It's the strongest level in the game.
• Choose the board and piece material from the menu: Wood, Antique Wood, Metal, Plastic or Marble. Your choice is remembered for future games.




Animated virtual opponents with their own names and personalities
Three difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard – perfect for beginners and experienced players
"Check!" and checkmate announced right on the board
Everything you need for a proper game

Chess clock with 5, 10, 15, 30 minutes or no time limit
Play as White, Black or random
Hint button, Undo and Resign
Full move list in standard notation
Floating panel you can show, hide and recenter at any time
Italian and English The whole interface is available in Italian and English.

Whether you want a relaxing game at home or serious practice, Scacchi MR turns any room into your chess club.
